The '''Matcha Flavoured Wiki''' is an unofficial encyclopedia of the [[Matcha Flavoured]] datapack, modeled on the Minecraft Wiki. It is not made or endorsed by the pack's developer.

== Sources ==
Every article is written from primary sources: the pack's own repository (datapack functions and JSON, and the resource pack's language file) at a fixed commit, the official release notes on Modrinth, and the developer's videos. Where the code and the notes disagree, the wiki describes the code. Many tables, such as recipes, loot and trades, are generated directly from the data, and the "Source" links in references point to the exact files in the repository. The wiki describes the latest release, {{Current version}}, together with the bug fixes already on the repository's <code>main</code> branch.

== License ==
Matcha Flavoured is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 license, and so are the textures and data this wiki reproduces. Wiki text is shared under the same terms.
